newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Gold Bridge plans 1-for-1 bonus.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Gold Bridge plans 1-for-1 bonus.

text.p: Construction firm Gold Bridge Engineering & Construction Bhd said on Wednesday it was planning a bonus issue of 18 million shares in the ratio of one share for every one held.
It said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that it was also proposing a rights issue of 36 million shares in the ratio of two shares for every one held at 3.10 ringgit per share.

The company said it was also planning to jointly develop a shopping mall in joint venture with privately-owned Aseania Development Sdn Bhd. Gold Bridge will hold 45 percent equity in the 240-million ringgit project on Penang island.
A bulk of the funds raised from the rights issue will be used in funding the joint venture, the company said.
